notes.title: Road to Boruto and 60 FPS now available!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10857200/8e9236681d50a84fafb8edeab96fc5e0124e310c.png

Road to Boruto, the expansion for Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4, is now available! 

The expansion comes with 7 new playable characters: 

Boruto
Boruto Scientific Ninja Tool
Sarada
Mitsuki
Naruto 7th Hokage
Sasuke Wandering Shinobi
Mecha Naruto


It also contains new costumes, new stages and new modes, such as Boruto's Tale! 

The expansion also came with a patch, unlocking 60fps on PC, Spectator Mode and 8 player endless mode!

notes.content:

notes.title: DLC 3 Patchnotes - May 2nd
notes.content:
Dear Naruto Fans, 

On 02/05 a new patch have been deployed for Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4. It includes the content of the DLC 3 (available on 03/05 for Season Pass owners and 10/05 for everyone else) as well as some bug fixes. 

IMPORTANT: The DLC 3 accessibility issue has been fixed.

Patch notes of the DLC 3 patch: 

New playable characters: 

Jirobo
Kidomaru
Ukon / Sakon
Tayuya


New combination Secret Techniques: 

Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist: “Seven Blades of the Blood Mist”
Sound Four: “Ninja Art: Underworld Formation”
Zabuza x Haku: “Cold Assault of the Demon Blade”

10 matching voices

10 Ninja Info Cards


Bug fixes: 

The stability of the Free Battle Mode has been improved
Text issues have been corrected


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3mE-usRSSL8

notes.content:

notes.title: DLC 2 Patchnotes - April 4th, 2016
notes.content:
Dear Naruto Fans, 

Thanks to your numerous feedbacks and continuous support of the game, we are pleased to share the bug fixes list including the DLC2. The patch was deployed on April 4th for all users. 

Patchnotes for the DLC 2 patch, deployed on April 4th: 

Graphics models during Awakening and Ultimate Combination Techniques have been improved.
The stability of the game in the Adventure Mode have been improved.
The stability of the game in the Online Mode have been improved.
The stability of the game on the Ninja Info Card have been improved: save games should not be lost anymore after editing the Ninja Info Card !
The stability of the game on the Combination Secret Techniques (such as Kisame’s) have been improved.


Sorry for the delay in posting those patchnotes. 

Thank you for your abundant feedbacks, don’t hesitate to share it with us on the STEAM forums, our Facebook Page and our Twitter Account! 

If you have a technical issue, please contact our Customer Support: 

Europe, Africa, & Asia: Support Page
North & South America: Support Page

notes.title: Patch notes - 19th February 2016
notes.content:
In order to further improve your experience of NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 4 on STEAM, a new patch will be deployed on February 19th at 4pm CET. You will need to restart your game to apply these changes. 

Please find below the list of modifications:

PC compatibility: performance have been improved on a variety of configurations
Language: all available languages are now selectable in the Steam Properties menu.
UI: A “return to Default” option has been added to the Keyboard Settings menu
Audio: the character 'Ino Yamanaka (Great Ninja War)' will now have a voice-over on the winner screen


This patch should improve the performance of the game on some of the less powerful configurations. The new minimum requirements will be added to the Store Page and communicated in the coming days. 

Thank you for your abundant feedbacks, don’t hesitate to share it with us on the STEAM forums, our Facebook Page and our Twitter Account! 

If you have a technical issue, please contact our Customer Support:

notes.title: 12th February 2016 – Patch notes
notes.content:
A patch will be deployed today, February 12th at 4.00pm CET. You will need to restart your game to apply these changes. 

Please find below the list of modifications: 


Audio: the issue with the mono sound on the left side has been fixed
Audio: the game will not lose the sound after reconnecting an audio device
Audio: the background music will now correctly work in the Rumble Shop in the Village Hidden in the Cloud in Adventure Mode
Keyboard compatibility: the game will not lose keyboard input after a match

notes.title: Upcoming patches & minimum requirements
notes.content:
Dear Naruto Fans, 

Thank you all for your support of the release of NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 4. All of us at BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment appreciate the abundant feedback you’ve shared with us, positive and negative! Rest assured we are closely monitoring the situation around the STEAM version of the game, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us on the STEAM forums, on our Official Facebook Page and through Twitter. 

We are happy to inform you that patches are planned and will be released shortly. These patches will focus on the most important issues you have reported. Patch notes and additional updates will be shared soon, so stay tuned! 

Currently our dev team is working diligently to make the game available to more players with various PC configurations. Thank you all for your patience and support. To enjoy the game on Steam, we would like to remind you the minimum configuration required to play NARUTO Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4: 
 

OS: Windows (64bit) 7 or higher up to date 
Processor: Intel i3-530, 2.93Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 940, 3.0GHz 
Memory: 4 GB RAM 
Graphics: 2048 MB video card, Pixel Shader 5.0 
DirectX: Version 11 
Storage: 40 GB available space
